summary_en: Gifti Group to acquire DIRIGIO (mobile ordering platform) in two stages: (1) acquire majority voting stake (67.1%) via third-party capital subscription and existing shareholder purchases by 2026-08-31, making DIRIGIO a consolidated subsidiary; (2) complete full ownership via simplified stock exchange by 2026-09-30, with DIRIGIO CEO to receive Gifti shares as continuing-performance incentive.
title_en: Notice of Consolidation of DIRIGIO as a Consolidated Subsidiary and Full Ownership via Simplified Stock Exchange
translation_en_brief:
Gifti Group announced on 2026-08-14 that its board has approved a two-stage acquisition of DIRIGIO, a related company currently accounted for under the equity method. DIRIGIO operates the PICKS mobile ordering platform for restaurants, leveraging deep customization and third-party system integration capabilities.

Stage 1 (Consolidation): By 2026-08-31, Gifti will subscribe to DIRIGIO's third-party capital increase, acquire shares from existing DIRIGIO shareholders, and purchase DIRIGIO shares and convertible bonds from its wholly owned subsidiary Gifti Inc. These transactions will raise Gifti's voting stake to 67.1%, making DIRIGIO a consolidated subsidiary.

Stage 2 (Full Ownership): Gifti will then execute a simplified stock exchange (under Companies Act Article 796-2, requiring no Gifti shareholder approval) to acquire remaining DIRIGIO shares by 2026-09-30 effective date. DIRIGIO shareholders will receive Gifti ordinary shares as consideration, with DIRIGIO's CEO to receive Gifti shares as an incentive to drive synergies and group value creation. The transaction is designed to accelerate unified operational management, strategic decision-making, and cross-selling across the e-gift platform and mobile ordering ecosystem.
